The '''2022–23 [[FC Barcelona|Futbol Club Barcelona]] season''' was the club's [[List of FC Barcelona seasons|124th season in existence]] and their [[La Liga records and statistics#All-time table|92nd consecutive season]] in the top flight. In addition to the [[2022–23 La Liga|domestic league]], Barcelona participated in this season's editions of the [[2022–23 Copa del Rey|Copa del Rey]], the [[2022–23 Supercopa de España|Supercopa de España]], the [[2022–23 UEFA Champions League|UEFA Champions League]] (entering for the [[FC Barcelona in international football#European Cup / Champions League|19th consecutive season]]), and the [[2022–23 UEFA Europa League|UEFA Europa League]]. The season covered the period from 1 July 2022 until 30 June 2023.

This was the last season for Barcelona's defender [[Gerard Piqué]], who retired before the winter [[2022 FIFA World Cup|World Cup]]. Piqué had spent fifteen seasons with Barcelona and won thirty official trophies with the club.<ref>{{cite news |last=Morse |first=Ben |date=4 November 2022 |title=Barcelona defender Gerard Piqué announces retirement at age 35 |url=https://www.cnn.com/2022/11/04/football/gerard-pique-retirement-barcelona-spain-spt-intl/index.html |access-date=10 January 2023 |publisher=CNN |archive-date=7 October 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20241007091729/https://www.cnn.com/2022/11/04/football/gerard-pique-retirement-barcelona-spain-spt-intl/index.html |url-status=live}}</ref> Furthermore, [[Captain (association football)|captain]] [[Sergio Busquets]] announced that he would leave the club at the end of the season after eighteen years with Barcelona, having won 32 trophies with the Catalans.<ref name=":0">{{cite news |date=10 May 2023 |title=Sergio Busquets to leave FC Barcelona at the end of the season |url=https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/3334561/sergio-busquets-to-leave-fc-barcelona-at-the-end-of-the-season |access-date=11 May 2023 |publisher=FC Barcelona |archive-date=9 February 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240209182649/https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/3334561/sergio-busquets-to-leave-fc-barcelona-at-the-end-of-the-season |url-status=live}}</ref> This was also [[Jordi Alba]]'s last season at Barcelona after eleven years, having won nineteen trophies with the club.<ref name=":4">{{Cite web |date=24 May 2023 |title=Jordi Alba to leave FC Barcelona at the end of the season |url=https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/3486018/jordi-alba-to-leave-fc-barcelona-at-the-end-of-the-season |access-date=25 May 2023 |publisher=FC Barcelona |archive-date=31 May 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230531132839/https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/3486018/jordi-alba-to-leave-fc-barcelona-at-the-end-of-the-season |url-status=live}}</ref>

On 15 January 2023, Barcelona clinched their first trophy since [[2021 Copa del Rey final|2021]] by defeating [[Real Madrid CF|Real Madrid]] 3–1 in the [[2023 Supercopa de España final|Supercopa de España final]].<ref>{{cite web | url=https://edition.cnn.com/2023/01/16/football/barcelona-spanish-super-cup-real-madrid-spt-intl/index.html | title=Barcelona wins Spanish Super Cup after beating Real Madrid 3-1 in final hosted by Saudi Arabia | date=16 January 2023 | access-date=5 April 2023 | archive-date=20 March 2023 | archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230320101637/https://edition.cnn.com/2023/01/16/football/barcelona-spanish-super-cup-real-madrid-spt-intl/index.html | url-status=live }}</ref> On 14 May 2023, Barcelona mathematically clinched [[List of Spanish football champions|their 27th La Liga title]] with four games to spare, the first since the [[2018–19 FC Barcelona season|2018–19 season]].<ref>{{cite news |date=14 May 2023 |title=Barcelona win La Liga title for first time since 2019 |url=https://www.nytimes.com/athletic/4506269/2023/05/14/barcelona-la-liga-champions/ |access-date=14 May 2023 |website=[[The Athletic]] |archive-date=14 April 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250414133341/https://www.nytimes.com/athletic/4506269/2023/05/14/barcelona-la-liga-champions/ |url-status=live}}</ref>

==Season overview==
===Pre-season===
On 12 May, Barcelona announced reaching an agreement with [[Aston Villa]] for the transfer of [[Philippe Coutinho]] for €20 million.<ref name="Coutinho"/> A week later, Barcelona announced they would be touring the [[United States]] to play two friendlies against [[Inter Miami CF|Inter Miami]] on 19 July and [[New York Red Bulls]] on 30 July.<ref>{{cite news |title=FC Barcelona return to the United States to play two friendlies against Inter Miami CF and the New York Red Bulls |url=https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/club/noticies/2623208 |date=19 May 2022 |access-date=14 September 2026 |publisher=FC Barcelona |archive-date=17 September 2026 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260917120337/https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/club/noticies/2623208 |url-status=live}}</ref>

On 6 June, Barcelona announced that the pre-season would start with the players' medical examinations on 4 July.<ref>{{cite news |title=FC Barcelona to start the preseason on July 4 |url=https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/news/2638790/fc-barcelona-to-start-the-preseason-on-july-4 |date=6 June 2022 |access-date=14 September 2026 |publisher=FC Barcelona |archive-date=16 September 2026 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260916015512/https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/news/2638790/fc-barcelona-to-start-the-preseason-on-july-4 |url-status=live}}</ref> Two days later, the club also announced reaching an agreement for the sale of [[Ferran Jutglà]] to [[Club Brugge]] for €5 million.<ref name="Jutgla"/> Two days after that, Barcelona announced that they would also be playing against [[Real Madrid]] on 23 July and [[Juventus]] on 26 July.<ref>{{cite news |title=FC Barcelona to complete US Tour with games against Real Madrid and Juventus |url=https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/news/2642481/fc-barcelona-to-complete-us-tour-with-games-against-real-madrid-and-juventus |date=10 June 2022 |access-date=14 September 2026 |publisher=FC Barcelona}}</ref>

On 15 June, Barcelona announced the signing of [[Pablo Torre (footballer)|Pablo Torre]] from [[Racing Santander]] for a fee of €5 million.<ref name="Torre"/> [[Dani Alves]] also announced that day that he would be leaving the club, when his contract expires at the end of June.<ref name="Dani Alves"/> On 30 June, Barcelona and [[Sixth Street Partners|Sixth Street]] reached an agreement for the acquisition of a 10% share of the club's La Liga TV rights, with Barcelona generating a total capital gain of €267 million for the current season. Sixth Street would initially invest €207.5 million and in return would receive 10% of the club's La Liga TV rights for the next 25 years.<ref>{{Cite web |date=13 June 2022 |title=FC Barcelona and Sixth Street reach an agreement for the acquisition of a 10% share of the Club's LaLiga TV rights |url=https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/club/news/2662883/fc-barcelona-and-sixth-street-reach-an-agreement-for-the-acquisition-of-a-10-share-of-the-clubs-laliga-tv-rights |access-date=8 July 2022 |publisher=[[FC Barcelona]] |archive-date=16 October 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20251016043953/https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/club/news/2662883/fc-barcelona-and-sixth-street-reach-an-agreement-for-the-acquisition-of-a-10-share-of-the-clubs-laliga-tv-rights |url-status=live}}</ref>

On 1 July, Barcelona announced that [[Adama Traoré (footballer, born 1996)|Adama Traoré]] and [[Luuk de Jong]] would be leaving the club after completing their loan stint.<ref name="Traoré"/> Three days later, Barcelona announced the signing of [[Franck Kessié]] from [[A.C. Milan]], and [[Andreas Christensen]] from [[Chelsea F.C.|Chelsea]], both on free transfers.<ref name="Kessie">{{Cite web |date=4 July 2022 |title=FC Barcelona sign Franck Kessie |url=https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/news/2666705/fc-barcelona-sign-franck-kessie |access-date=8 July 2022 |publisher=[[FC Barcelona]] |archive-date=22 February 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250222094420/https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/news/2666705/fc-barcelona-sign-franck-kessie |url-status=live}}</ref><ref name="Andre">{{Cite web |date=4 July 2022 |title=Christensen, second signing for FC Barcelona |url=https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/2666783/christensen-second-signing-for-fc-barcelona |access-date=8 July 2022 |publisher=[[FC Barcelona]] |archive-date=10 December 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20241210083346/https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/2666783/christensen-second-signing-for-fc-barcelona |url-status=live}}</ref> On 8 July, Barcelona and [[Tottenham Hotspur F.C.|Tottenham Hotspur]] reached an agreement for the loan of [[Clément Lenglet]] for the rest of the season.<ref name="Lenglet">{{Cite web |date=8 July 2022 |title=Clément Lenglet loaned to Tottenham Hotspur |url=https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/2659569/clement-lenglet-loaned-to-tottenham-hotspur |access-date=8 July 2022 |publisher=[[FC Barcelona]] |archive-date=13 August 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240813193255/https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/2659569/clement-lenglet-loaned-to-tottenham-hotspur |url-status=live}}</ref> Three days later, Barcelona and [[Watford F.C.|Watford]] reached an agreement for transfer of [[Rey Manaj]].<ref name="Rey Manaj"/><ref name="Manaj2">{{Cite news |title=Official Manaj Joins Watford |url=https://www.watfordfc.com/news/official-manaj-joins-watford |date=12 July 2022 |access-date=12 July 2022 |publisher=Watford F.C. |language=en |archive-date=2 October 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20251002111117/https://www.watfordfc.com/news/official-manaj-joins-watford |url-status=live}}</ref>

On 13 July, Barcelona played their first pre-season friendly versus [[UE Olot|Olot]], which ended in a draw 1–1 from a poor Barcelona side. That day, Barcelona and [[Leeds United F.C.|Leeds United]] reached an agreement for transfer of [[Raphinha]] for €48 million, with the fee potentially rising to €60 million.<ref name="Raphinha"/> Barcelona also reached an agreement with [[Sporting CP|Sporting]] to loan [[Francisco Trincão]] for reported €3 million until the end of the season with an option to buy.<ref name="Trincao1">{{Cite news |title=Trincão loaned to Sporting Clube de Portugal |url=https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/2672239/trincao-loaned-to-sporting-clube-de-portugal |date=13 July 2022 |access-date=13 July 2022 |publisher=FC Barcelona |archive-date=21 March 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250321104607/https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/2672239/trincao-loaned-to-sporting-clube-de-portugal |url-status=live}}</ref><ref name="Trincao2"/> Three days later, Barcelona and [[FC Bayern Munich|Bayern Munich]] reached an agreement for the transfer of [[Robert Lewandowski]] for €45 million, potentially rising to €50 million.<ref>{{Cite news |title=Agreement in principle for the transfer of Robert Lewandowski |url=https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/2680144/agreement-in-principle-for-the-transfer-of-robert-lewandowski |date=16 July 2022 |access-date=16 July 2022 |publisher=FC Barcelona |archive-date=13 November 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20251113140947/https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/2680144/agreement-in-principle-for-the-transfer-of-robert-lewandowski |url-status=live}}</ref><ref name="Lewandowski"/> Barcelona also announced the squad for the US tour, taking 28 players to play four pre-season matches there.<ref name="UStour1">{{Cite news |title=The squad for the United States |url=https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/2679556/the-squad-for-the-united-states |date=16 July 2022 |access-date=16 July 2022 |publisher=FC Barcelona |archive-date=11 July 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230711105231/https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/2679556/the-squad-for-the-united-states |url-status=live}}</ref>

On 19 July, Barcelona started the US tour with a 0–6 win over [[Inter Miami CF|Inter Miami]] at [[DRV PNK Stadium]] in [[Fort Lauderdale, Florida|Fort Lauderdale]], [[Florida]].<ref>{{Cite news |title=6-0 win over Inter Miami |url=https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/matches/74800/inter-miami-cf-fc-barcelona-friendly-2022-2023 |date=19 July 2022 |access-date=19 July 2022 |publisher=FC Barcelona |archive-date=12 August 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240812144459/https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/matches/74800/inter-miami-cf-fc-barcelona-friendly-2022-2023 |url-status=live}}</ref> Later on, the club announced reaching an agreement with [[HNK Gorica|Gorica]] for the transfer of [[ Moussa Wagué]].<ref name="Wagué1"/> Two days later, Barcelona sold an additional 15% of the club's La Liga TV right to Sixth Street. In total, Sixth Street would receive 25% of the club's La Liga TV rights for the next 25 years.<ref>{{Cite news |date=21 July 2022 |title=FC Barcelona and Sixth Street reach agreement for the acquisition of an additional 15% share of the Club's LaLiga broadcasting rights |url=https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/club/news/2686108/fc-barcelona-and-sixth-street-reach-agreement-for-the-acquisition-of-an-additional-15-share-of-the-clubs-laliga-broadcasting-rights |access-date=21 July 2022 |publisher=[[FC Barcelona]] |archive-date=6 September 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250906190730/https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/club/news/2686108/fc-barcelona-and-sixth-street-reach-agreement-for-the-acquisition-of-an-additional-15-share-of-the-clubs-laliga-broadcasting-rights |url-status=live}}</ref>

On 23 July, Barcelona won their second game of the US tour 0–1 over [[Real Madrid CF|Real Madrid]] at the [[Allegiant Stadium]] in [[Paradise, Nevada|Paradise]], [[Nevada]].<ref>{{Cite news |title=1-0 win over Real Madrid |url=https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/matches/74864/r-madrid-fc-barcelona-friendly-2022-2023 |date=23 July 2022 |access-date=23 July 2022 |publisher=FC Barcelona |archive-date=21 March 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250321101226/https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/matches/74864/r-madrid-fc-barcelona-friendly-2022-2023 |url-status=live}}</ref> Three days later, Barcelona drew 2–2 against Juventus in [[Dallas]], with [[Ousmane Dembélé]] scoring a brace.<ref>{{cite news |url=https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/2691359/match-report-dembele-nets-brace-as-fc-barcelona-and-juventus-draw-in-big-d |title=MATCH REPORT: Dembélé nets brace as FC Barcelona and Juventus draw in Big D |date=27 July 2022 |access-date=27 July 2022 |publisher=FC Barcelona |archive-date=20 May 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250520172731/https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/2691359/match-report-dembele-nets-brace-as-fc-barcelona-and-juventus-draw-in-big-d |url-status=live}}</ref> On 28 July, Barcelona reached a verbal agreement to sign French defender [[Jules Koundé]] from [[Sevilla FC|Sevilla]].<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/2689102/agreement-in-principle-with-sevilla-for-the-transfer-of-kounde |title=Agreement in principle with Sevilla for the transfer of Kounde |date=28 July 2022 |access-date=28 July 2022 |publisher=FC Barcelona |archive-date=28 July 2022 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220728171525/https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/2689102/agreement-in-principle-with-sevilla-for-the-transfer-of-kounde |url-status=live}}</ref> The next day, Barcelona announced the signing of Koundé on a 5-year contract for a fee of €50 million.<ref name="Koundé"/> In their final match of the US tour on 30 July, Barcelona defeated the [[New York Red Bulls]] 0–2 in [[Harrison, New Jersey|Harrison]], [[New Jersey]], with Ousmane Dembélé and Memphis Depay scoring a goal each.<ref>{{cite news |url=https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/2701283/barca-beat-red-bulls-2-0 |title=Barça beat Red Bulls, 2-0 |date=30 July 2022 |access-date=30 July 2022 |publisher=FC Barcelona |archive-date=9 December 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20241209235158/https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/2701283/barca-beat-red-bulls-2-0 |url-status=live}}</ref> Later on, the club reached an agreement with [[RC Celta de Vigo|Celta de Vigo]] for the transfer of [[Óscar Mingueza]] for €3 million.<ref name="Mingueza"/><ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/2709314/agreement-with-celta-for-mingueza-transfer |title=Agreement with Celta for Mingueza transfer |date=2 August 2022 |publisher=[[FC Barcelona]] |access-date=2 August 2022 |archive-date=24 March 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250324220353/https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/2709314/agreement-with-celta-for-mingueza-transfer |url-status=live}}</ref>

===August===
On 1 August, Barcelona announced the activation of the third 'economic lever', selling 24.5% of Barça Studios to [[Socios.com]] for €100 million "to accelerate the club's audiovisual, blockchain, NFT and Web.3 strategy".<ref>{{cite news |url=https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/club/news/2706416/fc-barcelona-official-announcement |title=FC Barcelona official announcement |date=1 August 2022 |access-date=1 August 2022 |publisher=FC Barcelona |archive-date=11 July 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230711105103/https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/club/news/2706416/fc-barcelona-official-announcement |url-status=live}}</ref> Three days later, [[Riqui Puig]] left for [[LA Galaxy]] on a free transfer.<ref name="Riqui Puig"/>

On 7 August, Barcelona and [[Neto (footballer, born 1989)|Neto]] reached an agreement for the termination of his contract.<ref name="Neto"/> Later on, the club concluded the pre-season with a 6–0 victory over Mexican club [[Club Universidad Nacional|Pumas UNAM]], winning the [[Joan Gamper Trophy]] for the 45th time. [[Pedri]] scored a brace, while [[Robert Lewandowski]], [[Ousmane Dembélé]], [[Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang]] and [[Frenkie de Jong]] contributed to the victory with a goal each.<ref>{{Cite news |date=7 August 2022 |title=FC Barcelona 6-0 Pumas UNAM: Things are looking very good! |url=https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/2732301/fc-barcelona-6-0-pumas-unam-things-are-looking-very-good |access-date=17 May 2023 |publisher=FC Barcelona |archive-date=29 April 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250429084120/https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/2732301/fc-barcelona-6-0-pumas-unam-things-are-looking-very-good |url-status=live}}</ref>

On 12 August, Barcelona announced the activation of the fourth 'economic lever', selling an additional 24.5% of Barça Studios to Orpheus Media.<ref>{{cite news |url=https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/club/news/2736062/fc-barcelona-official-announcement |title=FC Barcelona official announcement |date=12 August 2022 |access-date=14 September 2026 |publisher=FC Barcelona}}</ref> The next day, Barcelona were held to a goalless draw against [[Rayo Vallecano]] at [[Camp Nou]] in the first league match of the season. The new signings [[Robert Lewandowski]], [[Raphinha]], [[Andreas Christensen]] and [[Franck Kessié]] made their competitive debuts in this match.<ref name="BarcelonaGetafe">{{Cite news |date=13 August 2022 |title=FC Barcelona 0-0 Rayo Vallecano: Stalemate to start the season |url=https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/2742653/fc-barcelona-0-0-rayo-vallecano-stalemate-to-start-the-season |access-date=17 May 2023 |publisher=FC Barcelona |archive-date=24 March 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250324220751/https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/2742653/fc-barcelona-0-0-rayo-vallecano-stalemate-to-start-the-season |url-status=live}}</ref> Later on, [[Nico González (footballer, born 2002)|Nico González]] was loaned to [[Valencia CF|Valencia]].<ref name="Nico"/> Two days after that, [[Álex Collado]] also joined [[Elche CF|Elche]] on loan.<ref name="Collado"/>

On 21 August, the team got their first league win of the season, after they beat [[Real Sociedad]] 1–4 away. Robert Lewandowski scored twice, his first goals for the club, with the other two goals coming from Ousmane Dembélé and [[Ansu Fati]].<ref>{{Cite news |date=21 August 2022 |title=Real Sociedad 1-4 FC Barcelona: It's all starting to click! |url=https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/2754974/real-sociedad-1-4-fc-barcelona-its-all-starting-to-click |access-date=17 May 2023 |publisher=FC Barcelona |archive-date=29 April 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250429071737/https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/2754974/real-sociedad-1-4-fc-barcelona-its-all-starting-to-click |url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{Cite news |date=21 August 2022 |title=Robert Lewandowski scored his first competitive goals for Barcelona on his 34th birthday as the Catalan club won at Real Sociedad to record their first La Liga win of the season. |url=https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/62627905 |access-date=17 May 2023 |publisher=[[BBC]] |archive-date=11 July 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230711105817/https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/62627905 |url-status=live}}</ref>

On 24 August, Barcelona drew 3–3 against [[Manchester City F.C.|Manchester City]] at Camp Nou, in a charity match to raise funds in the fight against [[ALS]]. Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang, Frenkie de Jong and Memphis Depay scored for the ''Blaugrana''.<ref>{{Cite news |date=24 August 2022 |title=Barça 3-3 Manchester City: Charity goals galore |url=https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/2759138/barca-3-3-manchester-city-charity-goals-galore |access-date=17 May 2023 |publisher=FC Barcelona |archive-date=20 June 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240620200611/https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/2759138/barca-3-3-manchester-city-charity-goals-galore |url-status=live}}</ref> The next day, [[Samuel Umtiti]] departed for [[U.S. Lecce|Lecce]] on loan.<ref name="Umtiti"/>

On 28 August, Barça defeated [[Real Valladolid]] 4–0 with goals coming from Pedri, [[Sergi Roberto]], and a brace from Robert Lewandowski. [[Jules Koundé]] made his competitive debut in this match.<ref>{{Cite web |date=28 August 2022 |title=La Liga: Barcelona thrash Valladolid |url=https://www.theguardian.com/football/2022/aug/28/la-liga-barcelona-valladolid-espanyol-real-madrid |access-date=17 May 2023 |website=[[The Guardian]]}}</ref>

===September===
On 1 September, Barcelona announced reaching agreements with [[Martin Braithwaite]] to terminate his contract<ref name="Braithwaite"/> and with [[Chelsea FC|Chelsee]] on the transfer of [[Pierre Emerick Aubameyang]] for €12 million.<ref name="Aubameyang"/> The same day, [[Sergiño Dest]] and [[ Abde Ezzalzouli]] were loaned to [[A.C. Milan|AC Milan]] and [[CA Osasuna|Osasuna]] respectively,<ref name="Dest"/><ref name="Abde"/> and the club confirmed the signing of former [[La Masia]] graduate [[Héctor Bellerín]] from [[Arsenal FC|Arsenal]].<ref name="Bellerín"/> The next day, Barcelona also announced the signing of [[Marcos Alonso (footballer, born 1990)|Marcos Alonso]] from Chelsea.<ref name="Alonso"/>

On 3 September, Barcelona beat [[Sevilla FC|Sevilla]] 0–3 away. [[Raphinha]] and [[Eric García (footballer, born 2001)|Eric García]] both scored their first goals for the club with the other goal coming from Robert Lewandowski.<ref>{{Cite web |date=3 September 2022 |title=Sevilla 0-3 FC Barcelona: Simply spectacular! |url=https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/2779257/sevilla-0-3-fc-barcelona-simply-spectacular |access-date=17 May 2023 |website=FC Barcelona |archive-date=20 May 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250520125530/https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/2779257/sevilla-0-3-fc-barcelona-simply-spectacular |url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=3 September 2022 |title=Robert Lewandowski scores again as Barcelona breeze past Sevilla |url=https://www.espn.com/soccer/report/_/gameId/643806 |access-date=17 May 2023 |website=[[ESPN]] |archive-date=9 April 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250409164117/https://www.espn.com/soccer/report/_/gameId/643806 |url-status=live}}</ref> Four days later, Barcelona started the [[2022–23 UEFA Champions League|UEFA Champions League]] [[2022–23 UEFA Champions League group stage|group stage]] with a big 5–1 win against [[FC Viktoria Plzeň|Viktoria Plzeň]] in [[2022–23 UEFA Champions League group stage#Group C|Group C]]. Robert Lewandowski scored his first [[hat-trick]] for the club, Franck Kessié scored his first goal for the club, a goal from [[Ferran Torres]] completed the victory, and Pablo Torre came off the bench late on to make his debut for the club.<ref>{{Cite web |date=7 September 2022 |title=Barcelona 5-1 Viktoria Plzen: Lewandowski hits hat-trick in comfortable opening win |url=https://www.eurosport.com/football/champions-league/2022-2023/barcelona-v-viktoria-plzen-follow-live_sto9126329/story.shtml |access-date=17 May 2023 |website=[[Eurosport]] |archive-date=22 February 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250222124728/https://www.eurosport.com/football/champions-league/2022-2023/barcelona-v-viktoria-plzen-follow-live_sto9126329/story.shtml |url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=7 September 2022 |title=Barcelona 5-1 Viktoria Plzen: Lewandowski hat-trick on Champions League return |url=https://www.sport.es/en/news/barca/barcelona-5-1-viktoria-plzen-lewandowski-hat-trick-on-champions-league-return-75158187 |access-date=17 May 2023 |website=[[Sport (Spanish newspaper)|Sport]] |archive-date=17 May 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230517181740/https://www.sport.es/en/news/barca/barcelona-5-1-viktoria-plzen-lewandowski-hat-trick-on-champions-league-return-75158187 |url-status=live}}</ref> On the same day, Barcelona reached an agreement with midfielder [[Miralem Pjanić]] to terminate his contract.<ref name="Pjanić"/>

On 10 September, Barcelona beat [[Cádiz CF|Cádiz]] 0–4 away. Robert Lewandowski, Frenkie de Jong, Ansu Fati and Ousmane Dembélé got on the scoresheet with a goal each, while Héctor Bellerín and Marcos Alonso both made their debuts for the club.<ref name="CádizBarcelona">{{Cite web |date=10 September 2022 |title=Cádiz 0-4 FC Barcelona: The win is what matters least |url=https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/2787657/cadiz-0-4-fc-barcelona-the-win-is-what-matters-least |access-date=17 May 2023 |website=FC Barcelona |archive-date=10 December 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20241210090959/https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/2787657/cadiz-0-4-fc-barcelona-the-win-is-what-matters-least |url-status=live}}</ref> Three days later, Barcelona suffered a 2–0 defeat against [[FC Bayern Munich|Bayern Munich]].<ref>{{Cite web |date=13 September 2022 |title=Bayern Munich beat Barcelona to spoil Robert Lewandowski's return |url=https://www.espn.co.uk/football/report/_/gameId/652607 |access-date=17 May 2023 |website=[[ESPN]] |archive-date=24 February 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250224200611/https://www.espn.co.uk/football/report/_/gameId/652607 |url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=13 September 2022 |title=Bayern Munich 2-0 FC Barcelona: Frustrating defeat |url=https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/2789898/bayern-munich-2-0-fc-barcelona-frustrating-defeat |access-date=17 May 2023 |website=FC Barcelona |archive-date=5 October 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20231005013843/https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/2789898/bayern-munich-2-0-fc-barcelona-frustrating-defeat |url-status=live}}</ref>

On 17 September, Barcelona won 3–0 against [[Elche CF|Elche]], and achieved their best league start in the last five years, achieving 16 points out of a possible 18 from the first six matches. Robert Lewandowski scored a brace and the other goal came from Memphis Depay.<ref>{{Cite web |date=17 September 2022 |title=Barcelona 3-0 Elche: Robert Lewandowski at the double as Barca climb above Real Madrid to go top of La Liga |url=https://www.eurosport.co.uk/football/liga/2022-2023/barcelona-v-elche-la-liga-live_sto9146151/story.shtml |access-date=17 May 2023 |website=[[Eurosport]]}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=17 September 2022 |title=FC Barcelona 3-0 Elche: Powering onward |url=https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/2794198/fc-barcelona-3-0-elche-powering-onward |access-date=17 May 2023 |website=FC Barcelona |archive-date=29 November 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20231129222815/https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/2794198/fc-barcelona-3-0-elche-powering-onward |url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=17 September 2022 |title=Best league start in five years |url=https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/2794188/best-league-start-in-five-years |access-date=17 May 2023 |website=FC Barcelona |archive-date=11 July 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230711105833/https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/2794188/best-league-start-in-five-years |url-status=live}}</ref>

===October===
On 1 October, Barcelona continued their good form after the [[international break]] with another win, this time a 0–1 away win against [[RCD Mallorca|Mallorca]]. Robert Lewandowski scored the only goal of the match.<ref>{{Cite web |date=1 October 2022 |title=Mallorca 0-1 FC Barcelona: Another clean sheet, three more points |url=https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/2835302/mallorca-0-1-fc-barcelona-another-clean-sheet-three-more-points |access-date=17 May 2023 |website=FC Barcelona |archive-date=17 May 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230517181731/https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/2835302/mallorca-0-1-fc-barcelona-another-clean-sheet-three-more-points |url-status=live}}</ref> Three days later, Barcelona suffered a narrow 1–0 defeat against [[Inter Milan]] under controversial circumstances after Pedri had scored in the 67th minute, but it was ruled out by [[Video assistant referee|''Video Assistant Referee (VAR)'']] for a controversial handball by Ansu Fati. It was a night of controversy at the [[San Siro]] from VAR decisions, with another notable incident coming towards the end of the match when [[Denzel Dumfries]] appeared to handle the ball in the penalty area while trying to redirect a cross, however it was controversially ruled he had not conclusively knocked a cross away from Ansu Fati with his wrist.<ref>{{Cite web |date=4 October 2022 |title=Barcelona in Champions League danger after 1-0 loss at Inter Milan |url=https://www.espn.com/soccer/report/_/gameId/652621 |access-date=17 May 2023 |website=[[ESPN]] |archive-date=27 November 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20241127171452/https://www.espn.com/soccer/report/_/gameId/652621 |url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=4 October 2022 |title=Xavi said his Barcelona side suffered "a real injustice" after a 1-0 loss at Inter Milan left them in danger of a second successive group-stage elimination in the Champions League. |url=https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/63080315 |access-date=17 May 2023 |website=[[BBC]] |archive-date=13 August 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250813015649/https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/63080315 |url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{Cite magazine |date=4 October 2022 |title=Loss to Inter Ramps Up Pressure on Barcelona in Champions League |url=https://www.si.com/soccer/2022/10/04/inter-milan-barcelona-champions-league-group |access-date=17 May 2023 |magazine=[[Sports Illustrated]] |archive-date=14 January 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250114162514/https://www.si.com/soccer/2022/10/04/inter-milan-barcelona-champions-league-group |url-status=live}}</ref>

On 9 October, the team got their seventh league win in a row after winning 1–0 against [[RC Celta de Vigo|Celta Vigo]], with the only goal of the match coming from Pedri.<ref>{{Cite web |date=9 October 2022 |title=FC Barcelona 1-0 Celta Vigo: Seventh league win in a row |url=https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/2846186/fc-barcelona-1-0-celta-vigo-seventh-league-win-in-a-row |access-date=17 May 2023 |website=FC Barcelona |archive-date=6 December 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20231206071523/https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/2846186/fc-barcelona-1-0-celta-vigo-seventh-league-win-in-a-row |url-status=live}}</ref> Three days later, Barça were held to a dramatic 3–3 draw in the return fixture against [[Inter Milan]] at Camp Nou. Two goals from Robert Lewandowski and another goal from Ousmane Dembélé were not enough to give the team a much needed win in the Champions League, which left them in the risky position of not making it out of the group for the second consecutive season.<ref>{{Cite web |date=12 October 2022 |title=Barcelona 3-3 Inter Milan: Barca on verge of Champions League exit despite Lewandowski brace in thrilling draw |url=https://www.nytimes.com/athletic/live-blogs/barcelona-inter-milan-score/8NQ4XpVu1209/ |access-date=17 May 2023 |website=[[The Athletic]] |archive-date=7 October 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20251007062531/https://www.nytimes.com/athletic/live-blogs/barcelona-inter-milan-score/8NQ4XpVu1209/ |url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=12 October 2022 |title=Robert Lewandowski keeps Barcelona hopes alive in pulsating draw with Inter |url=https://www.theguardian.com/football/2022/oct/12/barcelona-internazionale-champions-league-match-report |access-date=17 May 2023 |website=[[The Guardian]]}}</ref><ref>{{Cite magazine |date=12 October 2022 |title=Barcelona Risked It All, Only to End Up on Brink of Early Champions League Elimination |url=https://www.si.com/soccer/2022/10/12/barcelona-inter-milan-champions-league-draw-lewandowski-xavi |access-date=17 May 2023 |magazine=[[Sports Illustrated]] |archive-date=17 May 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230517181730/https://www.si.com/soccer/2022/10/12/barcelona-inter-milan-champions-league-draw-lewandowski-xavi |url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=12 October 2022 |title=Barcelona 3-3 Inter Milan: Robert Lewandowski's dramatic late header keeps slim qualification hopes alive |url=https://www.eurosport.com/football/champions-league/2021-2022/champions-league-live_sto9179755/story.shtml |access-date=17 May 2022 |website=[[Eurosport]] |archive-date=22 February 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250222125520/https://www.eurosport.com/football/champions-league/2021-2022/champions-league-live_sto9179755/story.shtml |url-status=live}}</ref>

On 16 October, Barcelona suffered their first league defeat of the season, after losing 3–1 against [[Real Madrid CF|Real Madrid]] in the first [[El Clásico]] of the season. Ferran Torres scored the only goal for the team.<ref>{{Cite web |date=16 October 2022 |title=Real Madrid defeats Barcelona in El Clásico to go top of La Liga |url=https://edition.cnn.com/2022/10/16/football/real-madrid-barcelona-el-clasico-spt-intl/index.html |access-date=17 May 2023 |website=[[CNN]] |archive-date=4 December 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20231204180900/https://edition.cnn.com/2022/10/16/football/real-madrid-barcelona-el-clasico-spt-intl/index.html |url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=16 October 2022 |title=Real Madrid 3-1 FC Barcelona: Disappointment in El Clásico |url=https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/2855619/real-madrid-3-1-fc-barcelona-disappointment-in-el-clasico |access-date=17 May 2023 |website=FC Barcelona |archive-date=11 July 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230711110126/https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/2855619/real-madrid-3-1-fc-barcelona-disappointment-in-el-clasico |url-status=live}}</ref> Four days later, Barcelona defeated [[Villarreal CF|Villarreal]] 3–0, thanks to a brace from Robert Lewandowski and a goal from Ansu Fati.<ref>{{Cite web |date=20 October 2022 |title=Lewandowski double as Barcelona ease past Villarreal |url=https://www.espn.com/soccer/report?gameId=643866 |access-date=17 May 2023 |website=[[ESPN]] |archive-date=29 September 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230929113813/https://www.espn.com/soccer/report?gameId=643866 |url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=20 October 2022 |title=Doblete estelar de Lewandowski en solo dos minutos |trans-title=Lewandowski's stellar double in just two minutes |url=https://www.mundodeportivo.com/futbol/fc-barcelona/20221020/1001884092/publicar-lewandowski-vuelve-marcar-15-goles-oficiales-temporada.html |access-date=17 May 2023 |website=[[Mundo Deportivo]] |language=es |archive-date=11 July 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230711103323/https://www.mundodeportivo.com/futbol/fc-barcelona/20221020/1001884092/publicar-lewandowski-vuelve-marcar-15-goles-oficiales-temporada.html |url-status=live}}</ref> Three days after that, the team crushed [[Athletic Bilbao]] 4–0, with Ousmane Dembélé, Sergi Roberto, Robert Lewandowski and Ferran Torres getting on the scoresheet with a goal each.<ref>{{Cite web |date=23 October 2022 |title=Superb Dembele guides Barcelona to win over Athletic Bilbao |url=https://www.reuters.com/lifestyle/sports/superb-dembele-guides-barcelona-win-over-athletic-bilbao-2022-10-23/ |access-date=17 May 2023 |website=[[Reuters]] |archive-date=11 July 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230711105438/https://www.reuters.com/lifestyle/sports/superb-dembele-guides-barcelona-win-over-athletic-bilbao-2022-10-23/ |url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=23 October 2022 |title=El Athletic se suicida en el Camp Nou |trans-title=Athletic commits suicide at the Camp Nou |url=https://www.marca.com/futbol/primera-division/cronica/2022/10/23/6355789d268e3e8c028b456b.html |access-date=17 May 2023 |website=[[Marca (newspaper)|Marca]] |language=es |archive-date=17 May 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230517181730/https://www.marca.com/futbol/primera-division/cronica/2022/10/23/6355789d268e3e8c028b456b.html |url-status=live}}</ref>

On 26 October, Barça suffered a 0–3 defeat against [[FC Bayern Munich|Bayern Munich]] in the return fixture. The defeat meant that Barcelona were eliminated from the Champions League and couldn't advance from the group stages for the second season in a row, and were relegated to the [[2022–23 UEFA Europa League knockout phase|UEFA Europa League knockout stage]] for the second consecutive season. It was the first time since 1999 that the Catalan club failed to advance to the knockout stage of the Champions League in consecutive years, coinciding with the departure of [[Lionel Messi]] to [[Paris Saint-Germain F.C.|Paris Saint-Germain]] two seasons ago.<ref>{{Cite web |date=26 October 2022 |title=FC Barcelona 0-3 Bayern Munich: Disappointing exit from Champions League |url=https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/2876143/fc-barcelona-0-3-bayern-munich-disappointing-exit-from-champions-league |access-date=17 May 2023 |website=FC Barcelona |archive-date=27 November 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20241127193319/https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/2876143/fc-barcelona-0-3-bayern-munich-disappointing-exit-from-champions-league |url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=26 October 2022 |title=Bayern Munich beat Barcelona in Champions League to win group |url=https://www.espn.com/soccer/report/_/gameId/652665 |access-date=17 May 2023 |website=[[ESPN]] |archive-date=27 November 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20241127162541/https://www.espn.com/soccer/report/_/gameId/652665 |url=https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/2882015/valencia-0-1-fc-barcelona-lewandowski-late-show-rescues-three-golden-points |access-date=17 May 2023 |website=FC Barcelona |url-status=live}}</ref>

===November===
On 1 November, Barcelona ended their Champions League campaign with a 2–4 away win against [[FC Viktoria Plzeň|Viktoria Plzeň]]. Ferran Torres scored twice, while both [[Marcos Alonso (footballer, born 1990)|Marcos Alonso]] and [[Pablo Torre (footballer)|Pablo Torre]] both scored their first goals for the club. [[Iñaki Peña]] and [[Marc Casadó]] also made their debuts for the club.<ref name="PlzeňBarcelona">{{Cite web |date=1 November 2022 |title=Viktoria Plzen 2-4 FC Barcelona: Winning farewell to the Champions League |url=https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/2887111/viktoria-plzen-2-4-fc-barcelona-winning-farewell-to-the-champions-league |access-date=17 May 2023 |website=FC Barcelona |archive-date=6 December 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20231206084805/https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/2887111/viktoria-plzen-2-4-fc-barcelona-winning-farewell-to-the-champions-league |url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=1 November 2022 |title=Barcelona fire four past Viktoria Plzen |url=https://www.marca.com/en/football/champions-league/cronica/2022/11/01/63619d26268e3e770c8b456e.html |access-date=17 May 2023 |website=[[Marca (newspaper)|Marca]] |archive-date=22 February 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250222163521/https://www.marca.com/en/football/champions-league/cronica/2022/11/01/63619d26268e3e770c8b456e.html |url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=1 November 2022 |title=Viktoria Plzen 2-4 Barcelona: Bittersweet ending to the Champions League |url=https://www.sport.es/en/news/barca/viktoria-plzen-2-4-barcelona-bittersweet-ending-to-the-champions-league-78007805 |access-date=17 May 2023 |website=[[Sport (Spanish newspaper)|Sport]] |archive-date=17 May 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230517181733/https://www.sport.es/en/news/barca/viktoria-plzen-2-4-barcelona-bittersweet-ending-to-the-champions-league-78007805 |url-status=live}}</ref>

On 3 November, Barça's legend [[Gerard Piqué]] announced his retirement from football by releasing a heartfelt video on his social media accounts, having enjoyed a trophy-laden 14 years at the club since returning from [[Manchester United F.C.|Manchester United]] in [[2008–09 FC Barcelona season|2008]], during which he played 615 games for the team.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Morse |first=Ben |date=2022-11-04 |title=Barcelona defender Gerard Piqué announces retirement at age 35 |url=https://www.cnn.com/2022/11/04/football/gerard-pique-retirement-barcelona-spain-spt-intl/index.html |access-date=2023-01-10 |website=CNN |language=en |archive-date=2024-10-07 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20241007091729/https://www.cnn.com/2022/11/04/football/gerard-pique-retirement-barcelona-spain-spt-intl/index.html |url-status=live}}</ref>

On 5 November, the team beat [[UD Almería|Almería]] 2–0 with the goals coming from Ousmane Dembélé and Frenkie de Jong. [[Gerard Piqué]] played his final match for FC Barcelona in front of 92,605 fans who were gathered at Camp Nou to bid farewell to the club legend who was given an emotional standing ovation. There was a huge banner on the pitch that said 'Sempr3' (For3ver) and a video celebrating Piqué's career was played on the big screen to the fans as well.<ref>{{Cite web |date=5 November 2022 |title=Barcelona vs Almería summary: Piqué tributes in last home game |url=https://en.as.com/soccer/barcelona-vs-almeria-live-online-score-stats-and-updates-laliga-santander-2022-23-n/ |access-date=17 May 2023 |website=[[Diario AS]] |archive-date=27 April 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250427132843/https://en.as.com/soccer/barcelona-vs-almeria-live-online-score-stats-and-updates-laliga-santander-2022-23-n/ |url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=5 November 2022 |title=Barcelona bid farewell to emotional Pique with Almeria win |url=https://www.reuters.com/lifestyle/sports/barcelona-bid-farewell-emotional-pique-with-win-over-almeria-2022-11-05/ |access-date=17 May 2023 |website=[[Reuters]] |archive-date=20 May 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230520141544/https://www.reuters.com/lifestyle/sports/barcelona-bid-farewell-emotional-pique-with-win-over-almeria-2022-11-05/ |url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=5 November 2022 |title=Barcelona 2-0 Almeria: Gerard Pique says goodbye to Camp Nou |url=https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/63530795 |access-date=17 May 2023 |website=[[BBC]] |archive-date=17 May 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230517181729/https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/63530795 |url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=5 November 2022 |title=FC Barcelona 2-0 Almería: This one's for you, Gerard |url=https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/2893651/fc-barcelona-2-0-almeria-this-ones-for-you-gerard |access-date=17 May 2023 |website=FC Barcelona |archive-date=21 January 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250121053136/https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/2893651/fc-barcelona-2-0-almeria-this-ones-for-you-gerard |url-status=live}}</ref> On the same day, Robert Lewandowski was awarded [[La Liga Player of the Month]] award for the month of [[2022–23 La Liga#Awards|October 2022]].<ref name=":1" /><ref name=":2" />

On 8 November, Barcelona finished the first half of the season with a 1–2 away victory against [[CA Osasuna|Osasuna]], with the goals coming from Pedri and Raphinha. [[Chadi Riad]] also made his debut for the club. This was the last match for the team before the mid-season break for the [[2022 FIFA World Cup]].<ref>{{Cite web |date=8 November 2022 |title=Osasuna 1-2 FC Barcelona: Table topping comeback |url=https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/2899282/osasuna-1-2-fc-barcelona-table-topping-comeback |access-date=17 May 2023 |website=FC Barcelona |archive-date=18 January 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250118213048/https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/2899282/osasuna-1-2-fc-barcelona-table-topping-comeback |url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=9 November 2022 |title=Ten-man Barcelona fight back to win 2-1 at Osasuna after Lewandowski sees red |url=https://www.reuters.com/lifestyle/sports/ten-man-barcelona-fight-back-win-2-1-osasuna-after-lewandowski-sees-red-2022-11-08/ |access-date=17 May 2023 |website=[[Reuters]] |archive-date=11 July 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230711104733/https://www.reuters.com/lifestyle/sports/ten-man-barcelona-fight-back-win-2-1-osasuna-after-lewandowski-sees-red-2022-11-08/ |url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=9 November 2022 |title=Gerard Piqué and Robert Lewandowski sent off as Barcelona fights back to defeat Osasuna |url=https://edition.cnn.com/2022/11/09/sport/barcelona-osasuna-pique-lewandowski-la-liga-spt-intl/index.html |access-date=17 May 2023 |website=[[CNN]] |archive-date=23 November 2022 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20221123004128/https://edition.cnn.com/2022/11/09/sport/barcelona-osasuna-pique-lewandowski-la-liga-spt-intl/index.html |url-status=live}}</ref>

===December===
After the mid-season break for the World Cup, Barcelona returned to action on the last day of the year, when they played [[RCD Espanyol|Espanyol]] in the [[Derbi Barceloní|Barcelona derby]]. The hard-fought, tense and fiery derby ended in a 1–1 draw, with Marcos Alonso scoring the only goal for the team and the last goal of the year for the ''Blaugrana.''<ref>{{Cite web |date=31 December 2022 |title=Barcelona 1-1 Espanyol: Barca held in chaotic derby |url=https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/64136292 |access-date=17 May 2023 |website=[[BBC]] |archive-date=11 July 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230711105229/https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/64136292 |url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=31 December 2022 |title=Barcelona 1-1 Espanyol: Two red cards, late saves and VAR chaos as fiery derby ends in draw |url=https://www.eurosport.com/football/liga/2022-2023/la-liga-live_sto9294413/story.shtml |access-date=17 May 2023 |website=[[Eurosport]] |archive-date=27 February 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250227223234/https://www.eurosport.com/football/liga/2022-2023/la-liga-live_sto9294413/story.shtml |url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=31 December 2022 |title=FC Barcelona 1-1 RCD Espanyol: Tense derby ends all square |url=https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/3001364/fc-barcelona-1-1-rcd-espanyol-tense-derby-ends-all-square |access-date=17 May 2023 |website=FC Barcelona |archive-date=13 January 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250113010720/https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/3001364/fc-barcelona-1-1-rcd-espanyol-tense-derby-ends-all-square |url-status=live}}</ref>

===January===
On 4 January, Barcelona started the new year with a 3–4 away win after [[Overtime (sports)|extra-time]] against third-division side [[CF Intercity|Intercity]] in their first match in the [[2022–23 Copa del Rey|Copa del Rey]]. [[Ronald Araújo]],  Ousmane Dembélé, Raphinha and Ansu Fati contributed a goal each to help the team advance to the next round.<ref>{{Cite web |date=4 January 2023 |title=Intercity 3-4 FC Barcelona: Thriller decided in extra time |url=https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/3009399/intercity-3-4-fc-barcelona-thriller-decided-in-extra-time |access-date=26 May 2023 |website=FC Barcelona |archive-date=11 October 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20251011155759/https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/3009399/intercity-3-4-fc-barcelona-thriller-decided-in-extra-time |url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=4 January 2023 |title=Barcelona survive huge scare at third-tier Intercity to secure extra-time Copa del Rey victory, Ansu Fati nets winner |url=https://www.eurosport.com/football/copa-del-rey/2022-2023/barca-survive-huge-scare-at-third-tier-intercity-to-secure-extra-time-copa-del-rey-victory-ansu-fati_sto9300579/story.shtml |access-date=26 May 2023 |website=[[Eurosport]] |archive-date=28 February 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250228054046/https://www.eurosport.com/football/copa-del-rey/2022-2023/barca-survive-huge-scare-at-third-tier-intercity-to-secure-extra-time-copa-del-rey-victory-ansu-fati_sto9300579/story.shtml |url-status=live}}</ref> Four days later, the team got a hard-fought 0–1 away win against [[Atlético Madrid]] in the league. Ousmane Dembélé scored the only goal of the match.<ref>{{Cite web |date=8 January 2023 |title=Ousmane Dembele scored a first-half winner as Barcelona moved three points clear at the top of La Liga by edging to victory against Atletico Madrid. |url=https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/64206076 |access-date=26 May 2023 |website=[[BBC]] |archive-date=10 June 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230610060358/https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/64206076 |url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=8 January 2023 |title=Atlético Madrid 0–1 FC Barcelona: Three points clear at the top |url=https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/3013658/atletico-madrid-01-fc-barcelona-three-points-clear-at-the-top |access-date=26 May 2023 |website=FC Barcelona |archive-date=27 April 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250427233615/https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/3013658/atletico-madrid-01-fc-barcelona-three-points-clear-at-the-top |url-status=live}}</ref>

On 12 January, Barcelona advanced to the [[2023 Supercopa de España final|Supercopa de España final]] after they beat [[Real Betis]] 2–4 on penalties in the semi-finals, after the match had ended in a 2–2 draw after extra-time.<ref>{{Cite web |date=12 January 2023 |title=Real Betis 2-2 FC Barcelona: Super-finalists on penalties (2-4) |url=https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/3016987/real-betis-2-2-fc-barcelona-super-finalists-on-penalties-2-4 |access-date=26 May 2023 |website=FC Barcelona |archive-date=23 February 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250223013614/https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/3016987/real-betis-2-2-fc-barcelona-super-finalists-on-penalties-2-4 |url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=12 January 2023 |title=Real Betis 2-2 Barcelona AET (2-4p): Barca claim shootout win to set up El Clasico Supercopa final against Real Madrid |url=https://www.eurosport.com/football/spanish-supercopa/2022-2023/supercopa-de-espana-live-real-betis-v-fc-barcelona_sto9308661/story.shtml |access-date=26 May 2023 |website=[[Eurosport]] |archive-date=28 February 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250228062403/https://www.eurosport.com/football/spanish-supercopa/2022-2023/supercopa-de-espana-live-real-betis-v-fc-barcelona_sto9308661/story.shtml |url-status=live}}</ref> Three days later, Barcelona clinched their first trophy since [[2021 Copa del Rey Final|2021]] by beating [[Real Madrid CF|Real Madrid]] 1–3 in the [[2023 Supercopa de España Final|Supercopa de España final]].<ref>{{cite web |date=16 January 2023 |title=Barcelona wins Spanish Super Cup after beating Real Madrid 3-1 in final hosted by Saudi Arabia |url=https://edition.cnn.com/2023/01/16/football/barcelona-spanish-super-cup-real-madrid-spt-intl/index.html |website=[[CNN]] |access-date=5 April 2023 |archive-date=20 March 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230320101637/https://edition.cnn.com/2023/01/16/football/barcelona-spanish-super-cup-real-madrid-spt-intl/index.html |url-status=live}}</ref> [[Gavi (footballer)|Gavi]], Robert Lewandowski and Pedri scored a goal each.<ref>{{Cite web |date=16 January 2023 |title=Barcelona beat Real Madrid in Spanish Super Cup final |url=https://www.aljazeera.com/sports/2023/1/16/barcelona-win-3-1-over-real-madrid-in-spanish-super-cup-final |access-date=26 May 2023 |website=[[Al Jazeera Media Network|Al Jazeera]] |archive-date=3 December 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20241203003011/https://www.aljazeera.com/sports/2023/1/16/barcelona-win-3-1-over-real-madrid-in-spanish-super-cup-final |url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=15 January 2023 |title=Real Madrid 1-3 FC Barcelona: Super champions! |url=https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/3023492/real-madrid-1-3-fc-barcelona-super-champions |access-date=26 May 2023 |website=FC Barcelona |archive-date=14 December 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20241214191842/https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/3023492/real-madrid-1-3-fc-barcelona-super-champions |url-status=live}}</ref>

On 19 January, the team got a dominant away win against third-division side [[AD Ceuta FC|Ceuta]], beating them 0–5 thanks to goals from Raphinha, Ansu Fati, Franck Kessié and a brace from Robert Lewandowski, and advancing to the quarter-finals of the Copa del Rey. [[Ángel Alarcón]] made his debut for the club in this match.<ref>{{Cite web |date=19 January 2023 |title=Ceuta 0-5 FC Barcelona: Fast forward to the quarters |url=https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/3028544/ceuta-0-5-fc-barcelona-fast-forward-to-the-quarters |access-date=26 May 2023 |website=FC Barcelona |archive-date=24 January 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250124101839/https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/3028544/ceuta-0-5-fc-barcelona-fast-forward-to-the-quarters |url-status=live}}</ref> A day later, Barcelona announced that they had reached an agreement for the transfer of [[Memphis Depay]] to [[Atlético Madrid]] for €3 million plus one million in variables.<ref name="Memphis Depay"/>

On 22 January, the team got a 1–0 win in the league against [[Getafe CF|Getafe]], thanks to a goal scored by Pedri.<ref>{{Cite web |date=22 January 2023 |title=Barcelona 1-0 Getafe: Hosts extend La Liga lead as Pedri goal seals laboured win |url=https://www.eurosport.com/football/liga/2022-2023/barcelona-extend-la-liga-lead-as-pedri-goal-earns-laboured-win-over-getafe_sto9338703/story.shtml |access-date=26 May 2023 |website=[[Eurosport]] |archive-date=27 November 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20241127170552/https://www.eurosport.com/football/liga/2022-2023/barcelona-extend-la-liga-lead-as-pedri-goal-earns-laboured-win-over-getafe_sto9338703/story.shtml |url-status=live}}</ref> Three days later, Barcelona advanced to the semi-finals of the Copa del Rey after they beat [[Real Sociedad]] 1–0 in the quarter-finals, thanks to an Ousmane Dembélé goal.<ref>{{Cite web |date=25 January 2023 |title=FC Barcelona 1–0 Real Sociedad: Demb-olé! |url=https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/3038014/fc-barcelona-10-real-sociedad-demb-ole |access-date=26 May 2023 |website=FC Barcelona |archive-date=13 August 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240813174856/https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/3038014/fc-barcelona-10-real-sociedad-demb-ole |url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=25 January 2023 |title=Ousmane Dembele strike sends Barcelona into Copa del Rey semifinals |url=https://www.espn.com/soccer/report/_/id/663534 |access-date=26 May 2023 |website=[[ESPN]] |archive-date=26 May 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230526203833/https://www.espn.com/soccer/report/_/id/663534 |url-status=live}}</ref>

On 28 January, Barcelona got a narrow 0–1 away win in the league against [[Girona FC|Girona]], with Pedri scoring the only goal of the match.<ref>{{Cite web |date=28 January 2023 |title=Barcelona extend LaLiga lead to six points with narrow win over Girona |url=https://www.espn.com/soccer/report/_/id/643956 |access-date=26 May 2023 |website=[[ESPN]] |archive-date=30 May 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230530150334/https://www.espn.com/soccer/report/_/id/643956 |url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=28 January 2023 |title=Girona 0-1 Barcelona: Pedri on target as Barca seal narrow Catalan derby win to open up six-point La Liga gap |url=https://www.eurosport.com/football/liga/2022-2023/girona-v-barcelona-la-liga-live_sto9356549/story.shtml |access-date=26 May 2023 |website=[[Eurosport]] |archive-date=23 February 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250223030410/https://www.eurosport.com/football/liga/2022-2023/girona-v-barcelona-la-liga-live_sto9356549/story.shtml |url-status=live}}</ref> Three days later, Barcelona announced that they had reached an agreement for the transfer of [[Héctor Bellerín]] to [[Sporting CP|Sporting]] for €1 million.<ref name="Héctor Bellerín"/>

===February===
On 1 February, Barcelona got a 1–2 away win against [[Real Betis]], with Raphinha and Robert Lewandowski scoring a goal each.<ref>{{Cite web |date=1 February 2023 |title=Real Betis 1-2 Barcelona: Robert Lewandowski marks return with goal as Xavi's side go eight points clear |url=https://www.eurosport.com/football/liga/2022-2023/real-betis-1-2-barcelona-lewandowski-marks-return-with-goal-as-xavis-side-go-eight-points-clear_sto9363190/story.shtml |access-date=26 May 2023 |website=[[Eurosport]] |archive-date=27 November 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20241127174442/https://www.eurosport.com/football/liga/2022-2023/real-betis-1-2-barcelona-lewandowski-marks-return-with-goal-as-xavis-side-go-eight-points-clear_sto9363190/story.shtml |url-status=live}}</ref> Four days later, the team defeated [[Sevilla FC|Sevilla]] 3–0 to move eight points clear at the top of the league table. Jordi Alba, Gavi and Raphinha got on the scoresheet with a goal each.<ref>{{Cite magazine |date=5 February 2023 |title=Barcelona Move EIGHT Points Clear Of Real Madrid In La Liga Title Race |url=https://www.si.com/fannation/soccer/futbol/news/barcelona-8-points-clear-of-real-madrid-in-la-liga-title-race |access-date=26 May 2023 |magazine=[[Sports Illustrated]] |archive-date=27 November 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20241127171204/https://www.si.com/fannation/soccer/futbol/news/barcelona-8-points-clear-of-real-madrid-in-la-liga-title-race |url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=5 February 2023 |title=Xavi: FC Barcelona Can 'Win All The Titles We Have Left' After Sevilla Win |url=https://www.forbes.com/sites/tomsanderson/2023/02/05/xavi-fc-barcelona-can-win-all-the-titles-we-have-left-after-sevilla-win/?sh=34b276f664f9 |access-date=26 May 2023 |website=[[Forbes]] |archive-date=27 November 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20241127175456/https://www.forbes.com/sites/tomsanderson/2023/02/05/xavi-fc-barcelona-can-win-all-the-titles-we-have-left-after-sevilla-win/?sh=34b276f664f9 |url-status=live}}</ref>

On 12 February, Barcelona beat [[Villarreal CF|Villarreal]] 0–1 away, thanks to a goal from Pedri.<ref>{{Cite web |date=12 February 2023 |title=No hay quien pare a este Barcelona |trans-title=There is no one to stop this Barcelona |url=https://www.marca.com/futbol/primera-division/cronica/2023/02/12/63e90e3422601d560e8b45b8.html |access-date=26 May 2023 |website=[[Marca (newspaper)|Marca]] |url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=12 February 2023 |title=Villarreal 0-1 Barcelona: Pedri strike sends Xavi's side 11 points clear of Real Madrid in La Liga title race |url=https://www.eurosport.com/football/liga/2022-2023/villarreal-v-barcelona-la-liga-live_sto9381631/story.shtml |access-date=26 May 2023 |website=[[Eurosport]] |archive-date=25 February 2025 ===March===
On 2 March, Barcelona got a narrow 0–1 away win against [[Real Madrid CF|Real Madrid]] in the first leg of the [[2022–23 Copa del Rey#Semi-finals|Copa del Rey semi-finals]] thanks to an own goal from [[Éder Militão]].<ref>{{Cite web |date=2 March 2023 |title=Barca beat Madrid in Copa del Rey semi-final first leg |url=https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/64829271 |access-date=26 May 2023 |website=[[BBC]] |archive-date=11 July 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230711105229/https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/64829271 |url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=2 March 2023 |title=Real Madrid 0-1 Barcelona: Xavi's side edge tight Copa Clasico (part one) |url=https://www.nytimes.com/athletic/4269244/2023/03/02/real-madrid-barcelona-copa-del-rey/ |access-date=26 May 2023 |website=[[The Athletic]] |archive-date=7 October 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20251007044930/https://www.nytimes.com/athletic/4269244/2023/03/02/real-madrid-barcelona-copa-del-rey/ |url-status=live}}</ref> In this match, [[Sergio Busquets]] made his 46th appearance in the [[El Clásico]] breaking the record for the most [[El Clásico]] appearances ever by a player, previously held by [[Lionel Messi]] and [[Sergio Ramos]], both of whom had made 45 appearances.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2 March 2023 |title=Sergio Busquets breaks Clásico appearance record |url=https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/3091061/sergio-busquets-breaks-clasico-appearance-record |access-date=26 May 2023 |website=FC Barcelona |archive-date=23 July 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240723120155/https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/3091061/sergio-busquets-breaks-clasico-appearance-record |url-status=live}}</ref>

On 5 March, Barcelona defeated [[Valencia CF|Valencia]] 1–0, getting their 20th win of the season in [[2022–23 La Liga|La Liga]].<ref>{{Cite web |date=5 March 2023 |title=Barcelona 1-0 Valencia: Raphinha header sends Xavi's side nine points clear |url=https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/64856409 |access-date=6 March 2023 |website=[[BBC]] |archive-date=16 August 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240816134311/https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/64856409 |url-status=live}}</ref> [[Raphinha]] scored the only goal of the match, extending the team's lead at the top of the league table to 9 points.<ref>{{Cite web |date=5 March 2023 |title=Barcelona takes 9-point lead after Madrid held by Betis |url=https://apnews.com/article/barcelona-valencia-real-madrid-laliga-spain-soccer-9382ccfa8382e16f14fc43e96c4b33d2 |access-date=6 March 2023 |website=[[Associated Press]] |archive-date=28 July 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230728183828/https://apnews.com/article/barcelona-valencia-real-madrid-laliga-spain-soccer-9382ccfa8382e16f14fc43e96c4b33d2 |url-status=live}}</ref> [[Ferran Torres]] also missed a penalty in the 55th minute and in the 59th minute, [[Ronald Araújo]] got [[Fouls and misconduct (association football)|sent-off]] after committing a last-man foul, for which he was suspended for the next league match against [[Athletic Bilbao]].<ref>{{Cite magazine |date=5 March 2023 |title=Barcelona Beat Valencia Despite Ronald Araujo Red Card And Ferran Torres Penalty Miss |url=https://www.si.com/fannation/soccer/futbol/video/barca-beat-valencia-despite-penalty-miss-ronald-araujo-red-card |access-date=6 March 2023 |magazine=[[Sports Illustrated]] |archive-date=27 November 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20241127134306/https://www.si.com/fannation/soccer/futbol/video/barca-beat-valencia-despite-penalty-miss-ronald-araujo-red-card |url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=5 March 2023 |title=Barcelona hang on to beat Valencia with 10 men and stay on course for LaLiga title |url=https://www.espn.com/soccer/blog-the-match/story/4893608/barcelona-hang-on-to-beat-valencia-stay-clear-atop-laliga |access-date=6 March 2023 |website=[[ESPN]] |archive-date=11 April 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230411224003/https://www.espn.com/soccer/blog-the-match/story/4893608/barcelona-hang-on-to-beat-valencia-stay-clear-atop-laliga |url-status=live}}</ref>

On 12 March, Barcelona beat [[Athletic Bilbao]] 0–1 away, with [[Raphinha]] scoring the only goal of the match. The win helped keep the 9 point lead at the top of the table ahead of the [[El Clásico]].<ref>{{Cite web |date=12 March 2023 |title=Athletic Bilbao 0-1 Barcelona: Raphinha nets winner as Xavi's side edge match to restore nine-point lead |url=https://www.eurosport.com/football/liga/2022-2023/athletic-bilbao-v-barcelona-la-liga-live_sto9502612/story.shtml |access-date=12 March 2023 |website=[[Eurosport]] |archive-date=22 February 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250222235702/https://www.eurosport.com/football/liga/2022-2023/athletic-bilbao-v-barcelona-la-liga-live_sto9502612/story.shtml |url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=12 March 2023 |title=Barcelona move nine points clear of Real Madrid |url=https://www.marca.com/en/football/spanish-football/cronica/2023/03/12/640e467e46163fbf5b8b4594.html |access-date=12 March 2023 |website=[[Marca (newspaper)|Marca]] |archive-date=11 July 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230711105229/https://www.marca.com/en/football/spanish-football/cronica/2023/03/12/640e467e46163fbf5b8b4594.html |url-status=live}}</ref> This was Barcelona's 19th clean sheet in the league in which they have conceded only eight goals in 25 matches, breaking the record for fewest goals conceded after 25 matches, held jointly by [[Deportivo de La Coruña|Deportivo La Coruña]] in the [[1993–94 La Liga|1993–94]] season and [[Atlético Madrid]] in the [[1990–91 La Liga|1990–91]] season, both teams conceding 10 goals in 25 games.<ref>{{Cite web |date=13 March 2023 |title=Barça's defence continues to break records |url=https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/3108918/barcas-defence-continues-to-break-records |access-date=13 March 2023 |website=FC Barcelona |archive-date=22 February 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250222131109/https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/3108918/barcas-defence-continues-to-break-records |url-status=live}}</ref>

On 19 March, Barcelona defeated Real Madrid 2–1 in the league's second [[El Clásico]]. This win put the team 12 points in front at the top of the table and was also Barcelona's 100th competitive [[List of El Clásico matches|El Clásico win]], and third consecutive win against Real Madrid across all competitions.<ref>{{Cite web |date=19 March 2023 |title=Barcelona 2-1 Real Madrid: Barça take huge step towards title as Franck Kessié nets late winner in Clásico ===April===
After the [[FIFA International Match Calendar|international break]], the team continued where they left off, winning against [[Elche CF|Elche]] 0–4 away on the first day of the month. [[Robert Lewandowski]] scored a brace, while [[Ansu Fati]] and [[Ferran Torres]] scored one goal each. [[Aleix Garrido]] also made his debut for the club.<ref>{{Cite web |date=1 April 2023 |title=Elche CF 0–4 FC Barcelona: Robert Lewandowski hits brace as Barca go 15 points clear of Real Madrid at top of Liga |url=https://www.eurosport.com/football/liga/2022-2023/elche-cf-fc-barcelona-la-liga-live_sto9536590/story.shtml |access-date=1 April 2023 |website=[[Eurosport]]}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=1 recorded his 150th clean sheet since joining the club in 2014.<ref>{{Cite web |date=1 April 2023 |title=150 clean sheets for Ter Stegen at FC Barcelona |url=https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/3124105/150-clean-sheets-for-ter-stegen-at-fc-barcelona |access-date=10 April 2023 |website=FC Barcelona |archive-date=18 November 2025 On 10 April, the team got held to a goalless draw against [[Girona FC|Girona]] at home, and maintained their unbeaten home league record, extending the lead to 13 points at the top of the league table.<ref>{{Cite web |date=10 April 2023 |title=Barcelona extend lead at top of La Liga as home team held in goalless stalemate against Girona |url=https://edition.cnn.com/2023/04/23/football/barcelona-atletico-madrid-la-liga-spt-intl/index.html |access-date=23 April 2023 |website=[[CNN]] |archive-date=10 June 2023
