|date=23 April 2023 |title=Barcelona 1-0 Atletico Madrid: Ferran Torres strike gives Barca precious victory in La Liga title race |url=https://www.eurosport.com/football/liga/2022-2023/barcelona-v-atletico-madrid-la-liga-live_sto9570708/story.shtml |access-date=23 April 2023 |website=[[Eurosport]] |archive-date=22 February 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250222191042/https://www.eurosport.com/football/liga/2022-2023/barcelona-v-atletico-madrid-la-liga-live_sto9570708/story.shtml |url-status=live}}</ref> [[Marc-André ter Stegen]] equalled the club record for most clean sheets in the league in a season, previously achieved by [[Claudio Bravo]] in the [[2014–15 FC Barcelona season|2014–15 season]], in which he kept 23 clean sheets in the league.<ref>{{Cite web |date=23 April 2023 |title=Ter Stegen se cita con la historia |trans-title=Ter Stegen meets with history |url=https://www.sport.es/es/noticias/barca/ter-stegen-cita-historia-86400445 |access-date=23 April 2023 |website=[[Sport (Spanish newspaper)|Sport]] |language=es |archive-date=10 May 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230510185753/https://www.sport.es/es/noticias/barca/ter-stegen-cita-historia-86400445 |url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=23 April 2023 |title=Ter Stegen equals record for clean sheets |url=https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/3225877/ter-stegen-equals-record-for-clean-sheets |access-date=23 April 2023 |website=FC Barcelona |archive-date=18 May 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230518075403/https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/3225877/ter-stegen-equals-record-for-clean-sheets |url-status=live}}</ref> Three days later, Barcelona suffered their third league defeat of the season, losing against [[Rayo Vallecano]] 2–1 away. [[Robert Lewandowski]] scored the only goal for the team.<ref>{{Cite web |date=26 April 2023 |title=Barcelona stunned by Rayo Vallecano in surprise 2-1 defeat |url=https://www.reuters.com/sports/soccer/barcelona-stunned-by-rayo-vallecano-surprise-2-1-defeat-2023-04-26/ |access-date=26 April 2023 |website=[[Reuters]] |archive-date=11 July 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230711104728/https://www.reuters.com/sports/soccer/barcelona-stunned-by-rayo-vallecano-surprise-2-1-defeat-2023-04-26/ |url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=26 April 2023 |title=Rayo Vallecano 2-1 Barcelona: Below-par Blaugrana condemned to shock defeat |url=https://uk.sports.yahoo.com/news/rayo-vallecano-2-1-barcelona-215851242.html |access-date=26 April 2023 |website=[[Yahoo!|Yahoo!Sports]] |archive-date=2 May 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230502192724/https://uk.sports.yahoo.com/news/rayo-vallecano-2-1-barcelona-215851242.html |url-status=live}}</ref>

Barcelona ended the month with a 4–0 win against [[Real Betis]] on 29 April.<ref>{{Cite web |date=29 April 2023 |title=Barcelona edge closer to title with 4-0 win over 10-man Betis |url=https://www.reuters.com/sports/soccer/barcelona-edge-closer-title-with-4-0-win-over-10-man-betis-2023-04-29/ |access-date=29 April 2023 |website=[[Reuters]] |archive-date=11 July 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230711103324/https://www.reuters.com/sports/soccer/barcelona-edge-closer-title-with-4-0-win-over-10-man-betis-2023-04-29/ |url-status=live}}</ref> The match featured the returns from injuries of [[Ousmane Dembélé]] and [[Andreas Christensen]], who scored his first goal for the club. Aside from Christensen's goal, [[Robert Lewandowski]] and [[Raphinha]] also contributed to the win with a goal each, and the last goal was an own goal scored by Real Betis' midfielder [[Guido Rodríguez]].<ref>{{Cite web |date=29 April 2023 |title=FC Barcelona 4-0 Real Betis: Closing in on the title |url=https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/3246730/fc-barcelona-4-0-real-betis-closing-in-on-the-title |access-date=29 April 2023 |website=FC Barcelona |archive-date=14 June 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250614201118/https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/3246730/fc-barcelona-4-0-real-betis-closing-in-on-the-title |url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=29 April 2023 |title=El Barça desata la tormenta perfecta y la Liga ya está al caer |trans-title=Barça unleashes the perfect storm and the League is almost upon us |url=https://www.sport.es/es/noticias/barca/barca-desata-tormenta-perfecta-liga-86676118 |access-date=29 April 2023 |website=[[Sport (Spanish newspaper)|Sport]] |language=es |archive-date=30 April 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250430030052/https://www.sport.es/es/noticias/barca/barca-desata-tormenta-perfecta-liga-86676118 |url-status=live}}</ref> The match also had a special significance because 15-year-old [[La Masia]] graduate [[Lamine Yamal]] became the youngest ever appearance maker for Barça smashing the record which had been held by Armand Martinez Sagi since 2 April 1922. Martinez Sagi was aged 15 years, 11 months and five days when he appeared in a 1–1 draw against [[Sporting de Gijón]].<ref>{{Cite web |date=29 April 2023 |title=15-Year-Old FC Barcelona Prodigy Lamine Yamal Smashes Youngest Appearance Maker Record |url=https://www.forbes.com/sites/tomsanderson/2023/04/29/15-year-old-prodigy-lamine-yamal-smashes-fc-barcelona-youngest-appearance-maker-record/?sh=36956a171a6c |access-date=29 April 2023 |website=[[Forbes]] |archive-date=27 November 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20241127170449/https://www.forbes.com/sites/tomsanderson/2023/04/29/15-year-old-prodigy-lamine-yamal-smashes-fc-barcelona-youngest-appearance-maker-record/?sh=36956a171a6c |url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=29 April 2023 |title=15-year-old Lamine Yamal became Barcelona's youngest ever player, he looks a serious talent |url=https://www.sportbible.com/football/barcelona-lamine-yamal-15yearold-765439-20230429 |access-date=23 April 2023 |website=[[SPORTbible]] |archive-date=10 August 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250810172633/https://www.sportbible.com/football/barcelona-lamine-yamal-15yearold-765439-20230429 |url-status=live}}</ref>

===May===
On 2 May, Barça got a hard-fought 1–0 victory against [[CA Osasuna|Osasuna]]. [[Jordi Alba]] was the hero after coming on as a substitute in the 76th minute and scoring with an astonishing [[Volley (association football)|volley]] in 85th minute to give the team the win in epic fashion.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2 May 2023 |title=Barcelona 1-0 Osasuna: Substitute Jordi Alba hits late winner |url=https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/65458723 |access-date=2 May 2023 |website=[[BBC]] |archive-date=10 June 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230610060358/https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/65458723 |url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=2 May 2023 |title=Barcelona 1-0 Osasuna: Alba nets late winner as champions-elect narrowly beat 10-man visitors |url=https://www.eurosport.com/football/liga/2022-2023/fc-barcelona-ca-osasuna-la-liga-live_sto9586611/story.shtml |access-date=2 May 2023 |website=[[Eurosport]] |archive-date=22 February 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250222095209/https://www.eurosport.com/football/liga/2022-2023/fc-barcelona-ca-osasuna-la-liga-live_sto9586611/story.shtml |url-status=live}}</ref> [[Marc-André ter Stegen]] broke the club all-time record for most league clean sheets in a single season by achieving 25 league clean sheets this season, beating the 24 clean sheets record previously achieved by [[Andoni Zubizarreta]] in the [[1986–87 FC Barcelona season|1986–87]] season, and the most league clean sheets kept in a season in the 21st century, 23 clean sheets previously achieved by [[Claudio Bravo]] in the [[2014–15 FC Barcelona season|2014–15]] season.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2 May 2023 |title=Ter Stegen deja atrás a Zubizarreta: es el 'culé' con más porterías a 0 en una Liga |trans-title=Ter Stegen leaves Zubizarreta behind: he is the 'culé' with the most 0 goals conceded in a League |url=https://es.besoccer.com/noticia/ter-stegen-supera-zubizarreta-mas-porterias-0-liga-barcelona-besoccer-pro-1250177 |access-date=2 May 2023 |website=BeSoccer.com |language=es |archive-date=27 November 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20241127165321/https://es.besoccer.com/noticia/ter-stegen-supera-zubizarreta-mas-porterias-0-liga-barcelona-besoccer-pro-1250177 |url-status=live}}</ref> If Barcelona defeat [[Derbi Barceloní|city rivals]] Espanyol they could win La Liga.<ref>{{Cite web |last=López-Menchero |first=Tomás Hill |title=When can Barcelona win La Liga? |url=https://www.nytimes.com/athletic/4453936/2023/04/26/barcelona-real-madrid-la-liga-title-when/ |date=26 April 2023 |access-date=5 May 2023 |website=The Athletic |archive-date=18 January 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250118215302/https://www.nytimes.com/athletic/4453936/2023/04/26/barcelona-real-madrid-la-liga-title-when/ |url-status=live}}</ref>

On 10 May, Barcelona captain [[Sergio Busquets]] announced he would be leaving the club after 18 years and 722 appearances, the [[List of FC Barcelona records and statistics#Players records|third highest]] in the club's history after [[Lionel Messi|Leo Messi]] and [[Xavi (footballer, born 1980)|Xavi]]. During that time he has scored 18 goals and provided 40 assists. He has won 32 trophies with the club.<ref name=":0" /><ref>{{Cite web |date=10 May 2023 |title=Sergio Busquets: Barcelona captain to leave club at end of season after 18 years |url=https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/65544255 |access-date=11 May 2023 |website=[[BBC]] |archive-date=10 June 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230610060401/https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/65544255 |url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=10 May 2023 |title=Sergio Busquets to leave Barcelona after 18 years: Long-serving midfielder to depart Camp Nou |url=https://www.skysports.com/football/news/11095/12877551/sergio-busquets-to-leave-barcelona-after-18-years-long-serving-midfielder-to-depart-nou-camp |access-date=11 May 2023 |website=[[Sky Sports]] |archive-date=10 February 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250210074217/https://www.skysports.com/football/news/11095/12877551/sergio-busquets-to-leave-barcelona-after-18-years-long-serving-midfielder-to-depart-nou-camp |url-status=live}}</ref> Four days later, Barcelona won their [[2022–23 La Liga|27th La Liga title]] and the first since the [[2018–19 FC Barcelona season|2018–19 season]], after they beat [[RCD Espanyol|Espanyol]] 2–4 away from home.<ref>{{Cite web |date=14 May 2023 |title=FC Barcelona, Liga champions 2022/23! |url=https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/3344756/fc-barcelona-liga-champions-202223 |access-date=14 May 2023 |website=FC Barcelona |archive-date=2 December 2018 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20181202111602/https://www.fcbarcelona.com/ |url-status=live}}</ref> [[Robert Lewandowski]] scored twice and both [[Alejandro Balde]] and [[Jules Koundé]] scored their first goals for the club.<ref>{{Cite web |date=14 May 2023 |title=FC Barcelona Crowned La Liga Champions At Espanyol |url=https://www.forbes.com/sites/tomsanderson/2023/05/14/fc-barcelona-crowned-la-liga-champions-at-espanyol/?sh=3c2e42c3734d |access-date=14 May 2023 |website=[[Forbes]] |archive-date=11 April 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250411030401/https://www.forbes.com/sites/tomsanderson/2023/05/14/fc-barcelona-crowned-la-liga-champions-at-espanyol/?sh=3c2e42c3734d |url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=14 May 2023 |title=Dominant Barcelona beat Espanyol to clinch 27th LaLiga title |url=https://www.reuters.com/sports/soccer/dominant-barcelona-beat-espanyol-win-27th-laliga-title-2023-05-14/ |access-date=14 May 2023 |website=[[Reuters]] |archive-date=11 July 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230711103812/https://www.reuters.com/sports/soccer/dominant-barcelona-beat-espanyol-win-27th-laliga-title-2023-05-14/ |url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=14 May 2023 |title=Barcelona win La Liga title for first time since 2019 |url=https://www.nytimes.com/athletic/4506269/2023/05/14/barcelona-la-liga-champions/ |access-date=14 May 2023 |website=[[The Athletic]] |archive-date=14 April 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250414133341/https://www.nytimes.com/athletic/4506269/2023/05/14/barcelona-la-liga-champions/ |url-status=live}}</ref>

On 20 May, Barcelona were defeated 1–2 by [[Real Sociedad]] in what was their first and only league home defeat of the season, with Robert Lewandowski scoring the only goal for the team. After the match finished, captain Sergio Busquets lifted the La Liga trophy in front of 88,049 fans present at Camp Nou.<ref>{{Cite web |date=20 May 2023 |title=Champions Barcelona are beaten by Real Sociedad just before trophy lift |url=https://www.marca.com/en/football/spanish-football/cronica/2023/05/20/6469343cca474169308b4579.html |access-date=20 May 2023 |website=[[Marca (newspaper)|Marca]] |archive-date=25 February 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250225204922/https://www.marca.com/en/football/spanish-football/cronica/2023/05/20/6469343cca474169308b4579.html |url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=20 May 2023 |title=Barcelona 1-2 Real Sociedad - Visitors spoil hosts' La Liga title celebrations at Camp Nou |url=https://www.eurosport.co.uk/football/liga/2022-2023/barcelona-v-real-sociedad-la-liga-live_sto9612800/story.shtml |access-date=20 May 2023 |website=[[Eurosport]]}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last= |first= |date=2023-05-22 |title=Barcelona 1-2 Sociedad: Title celebrations fall flat for champions at Camp Nou |url=https://www.qatar-tribune.com/article/65612/sports/barcelona-1-2-sociedad-title-celebrations-fall-flat-for-champions-at-camp-nou |access-date=2025-11-24 |website=[[Qatar Tribune]] |archive-date=2025-12-19 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20251219043434/https://www.qatar-tribune.com/article/65612/sports/barcelona-1-2-sociedad-title-celebrations-fall-flat-for-champions-at-camp-nou |url-status=live}}</ref> Three days later, the team lost 3–1 away to [[Real Valladolid]]. Robert Lewandowski was the only one on the scoresheet for the ''Blaugrana''.<ref>{{Cite web |date=23 May 2023 |title=Real Valladolid 3-1 Barcelona: Champions suffer big loss as hosts get survival boost and Raphinha sends Vinicius message |url=https://www.eurosport.com/football/liga/2022-2023/real-valladolid-v-barcelona-la-liga-live_sto9618200/story.shtml |access-date=23 May 2023 |website=[[Eurosport]] |archive-date=28 February 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250228072607/https://www.eurosport.com/football/liga/2022-2023/real-valladolid-v-barcelona-la-liga-live_sto9618200/story.shtml |url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=23 May 2023 |title=Real Valladolid 3-1 Barcelona: LaLiga strugglers stun champions to climb out of relegation zone |url=https://uk.sports.yahoo.com/news/real-valladolid-3-1-barcelona-215738708.html |access-date=23 May 2023 |website=[[Yahoo!|Yahoo!Sports]] |archive-date=7 June 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230607013006/https://uk.sports.yahoo.com/news/real-valladolid-3-1-barcelona-215738708.html |url-status=live}}</ref>

On 24 May, Barcelona defender [[Jordi Alba]] announced that he would be leaving the club at the end of the season after reaching a mutual agreement with the club to terminate his contract one year before it was due to expire. Jordi Alba will be leaving the club after 11 years. During that time he has scored 26 goals and provided 91 assists. He has won 18 trophies with the club.<ref name=":4" /><ref>{{Cite web |date=24 May 2023 |title=Jordi Alba: Barcelona agree to terminate defender's contract at end of season |url=https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/65698943 |access-date=25 May 2023 |website=[[BBC]] |archive-date=10 June 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230610060403/https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/65698943 |url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=24 May 2023 |title=Jordi Alba: Barcelona agree mutual contract termination with 'ever-positive' defender, follows Sergio Busquets exiting |url=https://www.eurosport.com/football/liga/2022-2023/jordi-alba-barcelona-agree-mutual-contract-termination-with-ever-positive-defender-follows-sergio-bu_sto9620811/story.shtml |access-date=25 May 2023 |website=[[Eurosport]] |archive-date=27 November 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20241127162033/https://www.eurosport.com/football/liga/2022-2023/jordi-alba-barcelona-agree-mutual-contract-termination-with-ever-positive-defender-follows-sergio-bu_sto9620811/story.shtml |url-status=live}}</ref>

look, which it has had for 66 years, since its opening in 1957; before renovations of the stadium as part of the plan "''Espai Barça''" ("Barça Space") begin in the summer.<ref>{{Cite web |date=28 May [[Marc-André ter Stegen]] earned his 26th clean sheet of the season, equalling the all-time record in the league, set by [[Deportivo de La Coruña|Deportivo La Coruña]]'s [[Francisco Liaño]] in the [[1993–94 La Liga|1993–94]] season.<ref>{{Cite web |date=28 May 2023 |title=Barça see off Camp Nou, Busquets and Alba with easy Mallorca win |url=https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20230528-barca-see-off-camp-nou-busquets-and-alba-with-easy-mallorca-win |access-date=28 May 2023 |website=[[France 24]] |archive-date=11 July 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230711105103/https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20230528-barca-see-off-camp-nou-busquets-and-alba-with-easy-mallorca-win |url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{Cite news |date=28 May 2023 |title=Barça bid farewell to Camp Nou in style as they beat Mallorca |url=https://www.besoccer.com/new/barca-bid-farewell-to-camp-nou-in-style-as-they-beat-mallorca-1257405 |access-date=28 May 2023 |publisher=BeSoccer |archive-date=27 November 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20241127173508/https://www.besoccer.com/new/barca-bid-farewell-to-camp-nou-in-style-as-they-beat-mallorca-1257405 |url-status=live}}</ref> Tributes were made before and after the match to honor Sergio Busquets, Jordi Alba and the Camp Nou.<ref>{{Cite web |date=28 May 2023 |title=Spectacular fiesta brings down the curtain at Spotify Camp Nou |url=https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/club/news/3494056/spectacular-fiesta-brings-down-the-curtain-at-spotify-camp-nou |access-date=28 May 2023 |website=FC Barcelona |archive-date=15 January 2025 ===June===
On 4 June, Barcelona suffered a 2–1 away defeat against [[RC Celta de Vigo|Celta Vigo]] in their last competitive match of the season.<ref>{{Cite web |date=4 June 2023 |title=Celta 2-1 FC Barcelona: Losing end to a winning season |url=https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/3529471/celta-2-1-fc-barcelona-losing-end-to-a-winning-season |access-date=4 June 2023 |website=FC Barcelona |archive-date=17 June 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250617071647/https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/3529471/celta-2-1-fc-barcelona-losing-end-to-a-winning-season |url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=4 June 2023 |title=Celta Vigo 2-1 Barcelona: Veiga double secures safety as Celestes stun champions |url=https://ca.sports.yahoo.com/news/celta-vigo-2-1-barcelona-210403226.html |access-date=4 June 2023 |website=[[Yahoo! Sports]] |archive-date=4 June 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230604215314/https://ca.sports.yahoo.com/news/celta-vigo-2-1-barcelona-210403226.html |url-status=live}}</ref> The only goal for the team came from [[Ansu Fati]].<ref>{{Cite web |date=4 June 2023 |title=Celta beat Barca to beat drop, Valladolid down |url=https://www.espn.ph/football/report/_/gameId/644141 |access-date=4 June 2023 |website=[[ESPN]] |archive-date=22 February 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250222202414/https://www.espn.ph/football/report/_/gameId/644141 |url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=4 June 2023 |title=Celta Vigo 2-1 Barcelona: Veiga brace downs LaLiga champions on final day |url=https://www.sport.es/en/news/barca/celta-vigo-2-1-barcelona-veiga-brace-downs-laliga-champions-on-final-day-88296031 |access-date=4 June 2023 |website=[[Sport (Spanish newspaper)|Sport]] |archive-date=3 October 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20231003010047/https://www.sport.es/en/news/barca/celta-vigo-2-1-barcelona-veiga-brace-downs-laliga-champions-on-final-day-88296031 |url-status=live}}</ref> [[Robert Lewandowski]] secured the [[Pichichi Trophy]] after ending the league campaign with 23 goals – the most in the league.<ref>{{Cite magazine |date=4 June 2023 |title=Robert Lewandowski Wins 11th Golden Boot Award Of His Career After Outscoring Karim Benzema In La Liga |url=https://www.si.com/fannation/soccer/futbol/news/robert-lewandowski-wins-la-liga-golden-boot-ahead-of-karim-benzema |access-date=4 June 2023 |magazine=[[Sports Illustrated]] |archive-date=27 November 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20241127170140/https://www.si.com/fannation/soccer/futbol/news/robert-lewandowski-wins-la-liga-golden-boot-ahead-of-karim-benzema |url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=4 June 2023 |title=Robert Lewandowski, Liga top goalscorer |url=https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/3528648/robert-lewandowski-liga-top-goalscorer |access-date=4 June 2023 |website=FC Barcelona |archive-date=4 December 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20241204063430/https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/3528648/robert-lewandowski-liga-top-goalscorer |url-status=live}}</ref> [[Marc-André ter Stegen]] was aiming to secure two historic records in this match: the most league clean sheets in a season in history (top 5 leagues) and the least league goals conceded in a season; although he did not manage to secure either, he now holds both records alongside [[Francisco Liaño]], both having kept 26 clean sheets and having conceded 18 goals in a league season.<ref>{{Cite web |date=4 June 2023 |title=Ter Stegen no logra superar los récords de Liaño y Oblak e Iñaki Peña le sustituye |trans-title=Ter Stegen fails to surpass the records of Liaño and Oblak and Iñaki Peña replaces him |url=https://www.mundodeportivo.com/futbol/fc-barcelona/20230604/1002018318/ter-stegen-podra-superar-records-liano-oblak.html |access-date=4 June 2023 |website=[[Mundo Deportivo]] |language=es |archive-date=5 June 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230605093537/https://www.mundodeportivo.com/futbol/fc-barcelona/20230604/1002018318/ter-stegen-podra-superar-records-liano-oblak.html |url-status=live}}</ref> Ter Stegen also secured the [[Ricardo Zamora Trophy|Zamora Trophy]] for having the lowest goals-to-games ratio in the league (0.49).<ref>{{Cite web |date=4 June 2023 |title=Ter Stegen, Zamora Trophy winner for 2022/23 |url=https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/3529519/ter-stegen-zamora-trophy-winner-for-202223 |access-date=4 June 2023 |website=FC Barcelona |archive-date=4 June 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230604215313/https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/3529519/ter-stegen-zamora-trophy-winner-for-202223 |url-status=live}}</ref><ref name=":5" />

On 6 June, Barcelona ended the season with a [[Exhibition game|friendly match]] in [[Japan]] against Japanese side [[Vissel Kobe]], in honor of Barcelona legend [[Andrés Iniesta]] who played his last match for Vissel Kobe after five years at the Japanese club.<ref>{{Cite web |date=6 June 2023 |title=Vissel Kobe 0–2 FC Barcelona: Arigato, Iniesta! |url=https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/3530641/vissel-kobe-02-fc-barcelona-arigato-iniesta |access-date=6 June 2023 |website=FC Barcelona |archive-date=14 October 2025 [[Eric García (footballer, born 2001)|Eric García]] got on the scoresheet with a goal each.<ref>{{Cite news |date=6 June 2023 |title=Kessié opens the scoring for Barça, García adds another |url=https://www.besoccer.com/new/kessie-opens-the-scoring-for-barca-garcia-adds-another-1259751 |access-date=6 June 2023 |publisher=BeSoccer |archive-date=27 November 2024 [[Julián Araujo]], making their debuts for the first team.<ref>{{Cite web |date=6 June 2023 |title=The debutants against Vissel Kobe - one by one
